written_prompt_criterion: Physical depression of the target downward elevator call button
executed_success_criterion: Operator-confirmed physical contact between the gripper tip and the target button
reason: The physical elevator button was stiff; the operator accepted gripper-tip contact during execution.
feedback: The operator proactively sent success through the task interface.
interpretation: Reported real times measure completion under the contact criterion, not verified button depression.
